#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare GPT-4 vs Claude summarization of article.txt using automated metrics."""
import math
import os
import re
from collections import Counter

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def read(name):
    with open(os.path.join(HERE, name), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read().strip()


def tokenize(text):
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())


def stem(word):
    for suf in ("ing", "ed", "es", "s", "ly"):
        if word.endswith(suf) and len(word) > 4:
            return word[: -len(suf)]
    return word


def ngrams(tokens, n):
    return [" ".join(tokens[i : i + n]) for i in range(len(tokens) - n + 1)]


def rouge_n(ref, hyp, n):
    rt = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(ref)]
    ht = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(hyp)]
    rc, hc = Counter(ngrams(rt, n)), Counter(ngrams(ht, n))
    overlap = sum((rc & hc).values())
    prec = overlap / len(hg) if (hg := sum(hc.values())) else 0.0
    rec = overlap / len(rg) if (rg := sum(rc.values())) else 0.0
    f1 = 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) else 0.0
    return prec, rec, f1


def rouge_l(ref, hyp):
    rt = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(ref)]
    ht = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(hyp)]
    m, n = len(rt), len(ht)
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1 if rt[i - 1] == ht[j - 1] else max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])
    lcs = dp[m][n]
    prec = lcs / n if n else 0.0
    rec = lcs / m if m else 0.0
    f1 = 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) else 0.0
    return prec, rec, f1


def bleu(ref, hyp, max_n=4):
    rt = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(ref)]
    ht = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(hyp)]
    precs = []
    for k in range(1, max_n + 1):
        rc, hc = Counter(ngrams(rt, k)), Counter(ngrams(ht, k))
        overlap = sum((rc & hc).values())
        total = sum(hc.values())
        precs.append(overlap / total if total else 0.0)
    precs = [p if p > 0 else 1e-9 for p in precs]
    geo = math.exp(sum(math.log(p) for p in precs) / len(precs))
    bp = 1.0 if len(ht) >= len(rt) else (math.exp(1 - len(rt) / len(ht)) if len(ht) else 0.0)
    return geo * bp


FACTS = [
    ("Perovskite-silicon 33.7% efficiency", ["33.7"]),
    ("20% cost reduction by 2026", ["20% by 2026", "20 percent by 2026"]),
    ("China 80% manufacturing share", ["80%", "80 percent"]),
    ("$50B IRA solar investment", ["50 billion", "$50"]),
    ("Floating solar trend", ["floating"]),
    ("Dogger Bank 3.6 GW", ["dogger", "3.6 gw"]),
    ("15 MW turbines / 260m rotors", ["15 mw", "15-megawatt", "260"]),
    ("Offshore wind $50-60/MWh", ["$50-60", "50-60"]),
    ("Onshore wind $30-40/MWh", ["$30-40", "30-40"]),
    ("Battery storage 150 GWh", ["150 gwh"]),
    ("Storage tripled since 2021 (300%)", ["300%", "tripl"]),
    ("LFP replacing NMC", ["lfp"]),
    ("Sodium-ion batteries", ["sodium"]),
    ("Iron-air 100-hour storage", ["iron-air", "100-hour", "100 hour"]),
    ("Green hydrogen $3-4/kg", ["$3-4", "3-4 per kilogram"]),
    ("$2/kg hydrogen cost target", ["$2/kg", "$2 per"]),
    ("$500B global investment", ["500 billion", "$500"]),
    ("14 million jobs created", ["14 million"]),
    ("40 million jobs by 2030", ["40 million"]),
    ("Carbon pricing covers 23%", ["23%"]),
    ("Permitting delays 2-4 years", ["2-4 years", "2 to 4 years"]),
    ("Net-zero by 2050 goal", ["2050"]),
]


def fact_coverage(text):
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text.lower())
    hits = []
    for name, markers in FACTS:
        if any(m in t for m in markers):
            hits.append(name)
    return hits


def numeric_tokens(text):
    return [t for t in re.findall(r"[0-9][0-9.,$%/-]*", text)]


def stats(text):
    toks = tokenize(text)
    sents = [s for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text.strip()) if s]
    return {
        "words": len(toks),
        "unique": len(set(toks)),
        "sentences": len(sents),
        "avg_sentence_len": round(len(toks) / len(sents), 1) if sents else 0,
        "numbers": numeric_tokens(text),
    }


def main():
    article = read("article.txt")
    gpt = read("gpt4_answer.txt")
    claude = read("claude_answer.txt")

    print("=" * 70)
    print("AUTOMATED METRICS (reference = source article; extractive proxy)")
    print("=" * 70)
    hdr = f"{'metric':<28}{'GPT-4':>12}{'Claude':>12}"
    print(hdr)
    print("-" * 52)
    for name, fn in [
        ("ROUGE-1 F1", lambda h: rouge_n(article, h, 1)[2]),
        ("ROUGE-2 F1", lambda h: rouge_n(article, h, 2)[2]),
        ("ROUGE-L F1", lambda h: rouge_l(article, h)[2]),
        ("BLEU (1-4, smoothed)", lambda h: bleu(article, h)),
    ]:
        print(f"{name:<28}{fn(gpt):>12.4f}{fn(claude):>12.4f}")

    print()
    print("=" * 70)
    print("STRUCTURAL STATS")
    print("=" * 70)
    hdr = f"{'stat':<28}{'Article':>12}{'GPT-4':>12}{'Claude':>12}"
    print(hdr)
    print("-" * 64)
    a, g, c = stats(article), stats(gpt), stats(claude)
    for key, label in [
        ("words", "Word count"),
        ("unique", "Unique words"),
        ("sentences", "Sentence count"),
        ("avg_sentence_len", "Avg words/sentence"),
    ]:
        print(f"{label:<28}{a[key]:>12}{g[key]:>12}{c[key]:>12}")
    print(f"{'Compression ratio':<28}{'-':>12}{a['words']/g['words']:>12.1f}x{a['words']/c['words']:>12.1f}x")

    print()
    print("=" * 70)
    print("KEY-FACT COVERAGE (of 22 article facts)")
    print("=" * 70)
    g_hits = set(fact_coverage(gpt))
    c_hits = set(fact_coverage(claude))
    all_names = [f[0] for f in FACTS]
    print(f"{'fact':<40}{'GPT-4':>8}{'Claude':>8}")
    print("-" * 56)
    for name in all_names:
        print(f"{name:<40}{'YES' if name in g_hits else 'no':>8}{'YES' if name in c_hits else 'no':>8}")
    print("-" * 56)
    print(f"{'TOTAL covered':<40}{len(g_hits):>8}{len(c_hits):>8}")
    print(f"{'Coverage rate':<40}{len(g_hits)/len(FACTS):>8.0%}{len(c_hits)/len(FACTS):>8.0%}")

    print()
    print("Numeric tokens found — GPT-4:", g["numbers"])
    print("Numeric tokens found — Claude:", c["numbers"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import math
import os
import re
from collections import Counter

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def read(name):
    with open(os.path.join(HERE, name), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read().strip()


def tokenize(text):
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())


def stem(word):
    for suf in ("ing", "ed", "es", "s", "ly"):
        if word.endswith(suf) and len(word) > 4:
            return word[: -len(suf)]
    return word


def ngrams(tokens, n):
    return [" ".join(tokens[i : i + n]) for i in range(len(tokens) - n + 1)]


def rouge_n(ref, hyp, n):
    rt = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(ref)]
    ht = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(hyp)]
    rc, hc = Counter(ngrams(rt, n)), Counter(ngrams(ht, n))
    overlap = sum((rc & hc).values())
    hyp_total = sum(hc.values())
    ref_total = sum(rc.values())
    prec = overlap / hyp_total if hyp_total else 0.0
    rec = overlap / ref_total if ref_total else 0.0
    f1 = 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) else 0.0
    return prec, rec, f1


def rouge_l(ref, hyp):
    rt = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(ref)]
    ht = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(hyp)]
    m, n = len(rt), len(ht)
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1 if rt[i - 1] == ht[j - 1] else max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])
    lcs = dp[m][n]
    prec = lcs / n if n else 0.0
    rec = lcs / m if m else 0.0
    f1 = 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) else 0.0
    return prec, rec, f1


def bleu(ref, hyp, max_n=4):
    rt = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(ref)]
    ht = [stem(w) for w in tokenize(hyp)]
    precs = []
    for k in range(1, max_n + 1):
        rc, hc = Counter(ngrams(rt, k)), Counter(ngrams(ht, k))
        overlap = sum((rc & hc).values())
        total = sum(hc.values())
        precs.append(overlap / total if total else 0.0)
    precs = [p if p > 0 else 1e-9 for p in precs]
    geo = math.exp(sum(math.log(p) for p in precs) / len(precs))
    bp = 1.0 if len(ht) >= len(rt) else (math.exp(1 - len(rt) / len(ht)) if len(ht) else 0.0)
    return geo * bp
